name: Sika® Injection-222
summary: Sika® Injection-222 is a single component flexible hydrophilic MDI based urethane injection grout. Sika® Injection-222 reacts with water to form a permanent flexible closed cell polyurethane seal.
metaDescription: Sika® Injection-222 is a single component flexible hydrophilic MDI based urethane injection grout. Sika® Injection-222 reacts with water to form a permanent flexible closed cell polyurethane seal.
attributes: Reacts with fresh and sea water
usage: Seal leaks in concrete, masonry and brickwork
advantages: Reacts with fresh and sea water

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10°C and +30°C.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Sika® Injection-222 can be mixed with water before injection to increase the free rise ratio and to quicken the rise time. The water:resin ratio typically used is from 1:1 up to 1:4.

items.label: Reaction time
items.text:

25 | 1 | 120 | 2.5x
30 | 1 | 80 | 2.5x

Ratio | Cream Time (sec) | Rise Time (sec) | Free Rise Ratio
1:1 | 1 | 120 | 2.5x
1:2 | 1 | 130 | 3.5x
1:3 | 1 | 90 | 3.5x
1:4 | 1 | 80 | 3.5x

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text: Sika® Injection-222 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Sika® Injection-222 is ready to use from the pail. Make sure product is pre-conditioned before use to an optimum 20-25ºC. If product has crystallisation due to low temperature storage, indirect heating and mixing using a power drill mixer paddle may be required before use.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.
